status: Phase 3. Owners decided by Dante (D46); due dates accepted as proposals (D44); customer scoping decided (D42). The rest is Proposed.
notes: finding_rules: a finding is raised for every G1 field that is missing or contradictory. The first rule whose 'when' matches names the finding. Severity is the field's missing_severity (rules/fields.*.json, D29); a contradictory field takes the same severity as a missing one (SPEC 8.3, Proposed). min_severity can only raise it, never lower it (D20).

owners (D46): every finding has an internal owner (the role that follows up) and a resolving party (who must provide or fix the data). by_field (the field key without its a_end./z_end. prefix) wins over by_group, which wins over default. 'customer_technical_contact' becomes the technical contact of the finding's own end. Roles, not people: data owners are confirmed with a pilot carrier (SPEC 3.4).
due_in_business_days: the finding's due date is the evaluation date plus this many business days (Monday to Friday; holidays are not modeled).
stale_source_action: when every value that disagrees comes from a document of an earlier order version, the action is to have that document reissued.

customer_scoping (D42): any document of the package, emails included, that names a customer of the same tenant other than the order's own customer raises one critical SEG-OTHER-CUSTOMER finding, which blocks G1. Names are matched as whole words, case-insensitive, with or without the synthetic suffix. Full adversarial defense stays in Phase 7.
impact: 'confirmed' when the finding blocks the gate, 'possible' otherwise.
version_change: a field is reopened when its current value differs from the previous version's. plan_affecting marks which changed fields may move milestones; the plan itself is Phase 4.

customer_scoping.note_key: another customer of the tenant is named in the package

customer_date_change.note_key: an email gives a requested date different from the signed order form
customer_date_change.note: Severity high is Proposed (8.3: puts a date at risk); it does not block G1 (D43). The order form value stays until a new order version.
